answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 32184 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: if any non-muslim die Question: Please let us know what we should recite when we see or hear about any non-muslim die.(with respect to hadees) for muslim we recite "inna lillahi wa inna ilaihi rajioon. Thanks Answer ID: 32184 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 938/938/M=1432) We should remember our death and the hereafter. There is no harm if one recites this dua (انا للہ وانا الیہ راجعون) for this purpose. (Fatawa Mahmoodiah) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
